title: Measurements are not implicitly equated or confused
description: An ease rule pairs body and garment definitions only when their path types are the same (for example never a girth with a flat width) (D2P-SEM-071), and body and garment definitions are never used on the other side: size-entry and body-profile values and ease-rule body definitions are kind body; garment targets, fit targets and ease-rule garment definitions are kind garment (D2P-SEM-075).
